summary: Tested the Career Memory Masquer/Afficher toggles and the Radar geographic zone filter (zone.check, dashboard out_zone, reversible re-evaluation when the location changes, run offers kind=out_zone, Radar UI hors-zone filter, RadarHistory out-zone link and dialog). All requested features work. Backend: 23/23 pytest pass. Frontend: all flows pass. I found a few minor logic gaps (listed below), and none of them blocks anything.

minor.issue: A city missing from the PLACES list but in the member's province is kept as 'Province : Québec (ville non précisée)' even when it is far away. Real data example: 'Canada, Québec, Chicoutimi' (~400 km) is kept because Chicoutimi is not in PLACES (Saguenay is). The same happens with any small Québec city (Rouyn-Noranda, Gaspé...). The user only asked to keep same-province offers that give no city.

run.out_zone only counts offers newly inserted during the run. The kind=out_zone list also returns already-known offers seen in that run (seen_runs) that are hors_zone. So the number in the history row can be lower than the number of rows in the dialog.

An offer the member pastes is inserted as 'nouvelle' with no zone check. On the next location change, or a zone VERSION bump, _apply_zone re-evaluates it and can hide it as hors_zone. Behaviour is inconsistent; consider excluding source 'externe' from _apply_zone.
Ignoring a hors_zone offer replaces its status with 'ignoree' and leaves a stale status_before_zone (low impact).

issues: The hint for collapsed skills ('· 81 compétences') wraps onto 2 lines next to the Afficher button (left column too narrow). Cosmetic only.

action_items: Optional: for an offer city not in PLACES while the member's city is known, mark it out of zone, or say so explicitly in zone_reason (e.g. Chicoutimi), or add more Québec/Ontario cities to the list
Optional: make the RadarHistory out_zone count match the kind=out_zone list (count known hors_zone offers seen in the run too, or filter the list by run_id)
critical_code_review_comments: _apply_zone skips 'pack' offers, so packed offers in Toronto/Vancouver stay visible. This looks intentional and is fine.
_apply_zone loops with one update_one per offer. Fine for about 300 offers; a bulk_write would scale better.
deploy-export copies are identical to /app backend/frontend for all reviewed files.
seed_data_creation: Temporary radar_offers with id prefix TEST_zone_ (Toronto, Laval, Mississauga/ignoree) were inserted and then deleted. A temporary out_zone=3 on run eff640e1 was used for the UI test and removed. Settings location restored to 'Montréal, Québec' (zone_for 1|montreal quebec, 106 hors_zone offers).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_radar_zone.py covers the zone.check unit cases plus the dashboard, the Toronto<->Montréal reversible re-evaluation and run offers kind=out_zone. Its fixture restores the location to 'Montréal, Québec'. UI checks: profile-cv-block-toggle hidden by default (localStorage cos.profile.cv.open); skills-detected-toggle shown by default (cos.profile.skills.open); radar-out-zone-btn shows 106 and filters 106 radar-zone-reason-* cards; radar-run-outzone-<id> opens the dialog with run-offer-zone-* items. No real Radar run was triggered.
